The '''power relay vault''' was the name given to one of the vaults built by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in [[the Tomb]], an ancient [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Located in the [[abandoned Rakata machine chamber]], the vault was the site of several power relays that supplied the stasis generators throughout the Tomb, and so when the [[Esh-kha]] were released from imprisonment during the [[invasion of Belsavis]], they attempted to destroy the relays and free their brethren. The vault's computer intelligence recruited nearby individuals to secure the vault and activate the emergency relays.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The power relay vault appears as a location on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and is the site of the mission "A Safety Feature."<ref name="TOR" />
